local: Your files stay on your device
welcomeText: A space to organize your work, standardize names, and find what matters.
startText: Choose a local folder, set your rules, and make it your workspace.
continueProject: Pick up where you left off
rulesText: Normalize names and assign hierarchical folder codes.
privacyText: Files remain in your folders. Settings are stored locally in SQLite.
flexText: Multiple projects, independent configurations, no imposed template.
desktopNotice: Browser preview. Open the HFolder desktop app to work with real local files.
name: Name
emptyText: Create your first folder. HFolder takes care of the name and code.
noResultsText: Try another name or code, or clear your filters.
setupText: Set it up once. Stay organized every day.
rootHint: Empty folders are ready immediately. Existing files are checked and may require reconciliation.
widthHint: 1 to 6 digits per level. Deeper levels inherit the last width.
classificationHint: Leave these empty and configure later. These categories are independent of folder names.
addType: Enter a type and press Enter
addTag: Enter a tag and press Enter
copyHint: Copies rules and catalogs, not files or assigned codes.
reviewHint: Complete setup to save your project. Existing files are checked, never renamed automatically.
namingHint: Names are normalized with underscores and a unique code.
reviewBanner: Changes detected. Review flagged items before creating more folders.
confirmHint: Acknowledge only valid names and codes. Use Keep names and normalize to repair other items.
chooseEntry: Select an item to see details
updateUnavailable: The updater endpoint and public verification key are not configured yet. Update checks will be enabled with signed releases.
scopeNotice: This milestone adds batch normalization, hierarchical rename/code changes and interrupted-operation recovery. Move/import, taxonomy settings, watchers and signed updates follow later.
issueWrongParent: Code does not match the parent folder
issueWrongWidth: Code width differs from project rules
issueDuplicate: Code is shared by another item
repairHint: Keep existing descriptions or edit names. Preview normalized names and codes before changing files.
changeReviewHint: Check every path before applying. Affected descendants are included.
editBeforeNormalize: Edit names or codes before normalization
cascadeHint: Selecting a folder normalizes its subtree. Child codes follow the parent. File contents and extensions are preserved.
recoveryHint: A rename operation was interrupted. Writes are locked until the previous state is restored.
stalePreview: Files or settings changed after preview. Go back and generate a new preview.
targetExists: The destination already exists. Choose a different name or code; HFolder never overwrites it.
duplicateCode: This code belongs to another item. Choose another number.
recoveryConflict: An outside file is blocking recovery. Files were preserved; inspect the reported path before retrying.
parentNeedsRepair: The parent folder needs a valid code. Select the parent to normalize its subtree.
batchTooLarge: Up to 500 affected items per operation. Split this tree into smaller groups.
